test_sanitize_valid_arguments: test that AIAgent._sanitize_tool_call_arguments leaves valid JSON tool call arguments unchanged
test_sanitize_truncated_arguments: test that truncated JSON arguments in tool calls are replaced with an empty object
test_sanitize_marker_appended_to_tool_me: test that the corruption marker is prepended to an existing tool message content
test_sanitize_marker_inserted_when_missi: test that a new tool message with the corruption marker is inserted when none exists
test_sanitize_multiple_corrupted_calls: test that multiple corrupted tool calls in one message are each repaired and marked individually
